verdict.rationale: The evidence only loosely supports this story. Vue calls itself performant and incrementally adoptable, scaling from a library to a full framework (vue-docs-1, vue-docs-2). Community users say you can drop in a single vue.min.js file with no package manager or bundler (vue-comm-6) and use it minimally to enhance existing pages (vue-comm-4). Nothing quantifies bundle size, tree-shaking or dependency count, and another user reports that Vue apps still lean on build tooling (vue-comm-16). Missing for 10: documented bundle-size figures, tree-shaking or dead-code-elimination evidence, a zero or low runtime-dependency count, supply-chain risk posture, and independent size benchmarks.
